resources.string: Join, and what you just shared goes out
After copying something, pull down quick settings and tap "Send clipboard".
Pull down quick settings → edit → drag "Send clipboard" in.
Pairing code from a device you already use: the web inbox (Devices), Obsidian settings, or `dropit code` in a terminal
Agree and create a new account
First device? Create a new account

Tapping Join means you agree to this: joining sends this phone\'s name and a fingerprint hash, used only to manage your device slots. What you send is kept on the service for a short while (1 day on the free plan) so your other devices can receive it.

While a drop goes out, a small card shows at the bottom of the screen: this phone pauses apps that are not on screen. Let dropit run without battery limits and drops go out in the background, card-free.
